tools.name: create_diagram
tools.description: Create a diagram in AI Flowchart from a plain-English description and get a link that opens it as an editable board (edit, present as an animated slideshow, export PNG/PDF/PowerPoint). Flowcharts, sequence diagrams and mind maps also come back as Mermaid code. Types: flowchart, mindmap, sequence (AP

tools.name: code_to_flowchart
tools.description: Turn source code (C, C++, Java, Python or JavaScript, up to 80 lines) into a lab-record style flowchart where every box is linked to its code lines, plus a step-by-step dry run for a sample input (current line, box and variables at each step). Returns a link that opens it ready to play (▶ Explain),

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List AI Flowchart's ready-made templates (lab programs, UML and ER for student projects, system designs, charts, app walkthroughs, code programs…). Free — no AI credits.

tools.name: open_template
tools.description: Get a link that opens one of the templates (from list_templates) as a new editable board. Free — no AI credits.

tools.name: render_diagram
tools.description: Turn Mermaid diagram text into a hosted PNG and SVG image URL (cached on a CDN). Use it when a diagram has to go somewhere that cannot run Mermaid: email, Slack or Teams messages, PDFs, Word/Google Docs, Confluence, WhatsApp, a README. Returns the URLs plus ready-made Markdown and HTML. Free — no AI
